tool.name: Extract numeric genotypes from a VCF
tool.description: filter by regions and samples and generate numeric genotypes

param.name: vcf
param.label: VCF (variant call format) file
param.help: Bgzipped VCF in standard format, listing variant information and genotypes.

param.name: index
param.label: TBI tabix index for VCF
param.help: Index such as that generated by 'bcftools index --tbi'. Necessary for extraction of specific regions from the VCF.

param.name: bed
param.label: BED file of regions to include
param.help: BED files are tab-delimited. The first column contains the chromosome name, the second column the 0-indexed position indicating the start of the region, and the third column the 1-indexed position indicating the end of the region. tool.help:
**Extract numeric genotypes from a VCF**
Imports a BED file indicating regions to output, as well as a plain text file listing samples to include. Then uses VariantAnnotation to import the GT matrix from the indexed VCF. Only variants that pass filtering are retained. Outputs a tab-delimited text containing chromsome, position, reference and alternative alleles, and genotypes expressed as alternative allele count.
**Inputs**
- *VCF (variant call format) file* (vcf): Bgzipped VCF in standard format, listing variant information and genotypes.
- *TBI tabix index for VCF* (tbi): Index such as that generated by 'bcftools index --tbi'. Necessary for extraction of specific regions from the VCF.
- *BED file of regions to include* (bed): BED files are tab-delimited. The first column contains the chromosome name, the second column the 0-indexed position indicating the start of the region, and the third column the 1-indexed position indicating the end of the region. Additional columns are optional. The script will only process variants in regions defined by the BED file.
- *File listing samples to include* (txt): Plain text file listing one sample per line. Sample names must match the column headers in the VCF. Samples not listed in this file will not be included in the output.
**Outputs**
- *Table of numeric genotypes* (tsv): Gzip-compressed tab-delimited file with column headers. The first column, Chrom, indicates chromosome name. The second column, Pos, indicates the 1-indexed position. The third column, Ref, and fourth column, Alt, indicate reference and alternative alleles, respectively. All remaining columns indicate genotypes, with one column for each sample. Integers indicate counts of the alternative allele. Multiallelic loci are split into one row per alternative allele. Missing data are indicated by NA.
This tool was generated automatically by BiocJobs from the job specification `variantannotation-extract-numeric-genotypes` shipped in Bioconductor package **VariantAnnotation**.
